title: Personal Training Packages: booking advance window, no-show, reschedule, and late-cancellation window by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, how far ahead a session may be booked, whether missing a booked session without notice forfeits it, whether and how many times a booked session may be rescheduled, and the number of hours of notice a member must give before a scheduled session for a cancellation to avoid falling inside the late-cancellation window. The charge levied for a cancellation that falls inside that window is stated in the late-cancellation window and charge document, not here.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Booking advance window (hours) | No-show forfeits the session | Reschedule allowed | Reschedule limit per session | Late-cancellation window (hours before start) | Late-cancellation flat fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | 48 | Yes | Yes | 1 | 24 | 15.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | 48 | Yes | Yes | 1 | 24 | 15.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | 72 | Yes | Yes | 2 | 24 | 15.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | 96 | Yes | Yes | 2 | 24 | 15.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | 24 | Yes | Yes | 3 | 12 | 10.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | 96 | Yes | Yes | 2 | 24 | 25.00 |

## Points of reference
On every tier of Personal Training Packages, failing to show up for a booked session forfeits that session and rescheduling a booked session is permitted, up to the tier's own reschedule limit for that same session. The late-cancellation window is the number of hours of notice, counted back from the session's scheduled start, within which a cancellation is treated as a late cancellation rather than an ordinary one; Unlimited Monthly Coaching sets the shortest window, at 12 hours, and the largest single flat fee among the tiers shown, while every other tier sets a 24-hour window. Booking advance windows vary from 24 hours on Unlimited Monthly Coaching, whose sessions are booked closer to the session date, up to 96 hours on the two highest tiers.
